name: TrustArc Cookie Consent Manager
description: Injects and configures the TrustArc CMP (cookie-consent) script, banner and preferences link.
project_description:
Introduction 
 This module provides seamless integration between Drupal and TrustArc's Cookie Consent Manager, allowing site owners to manage user consent in compliance with data privacy regulations. It also enables integration with Google Consent Mode, ensuring that analytics and advertising scripts respect user preferences.

 
 Watch the overview on YouTube → 

 Features 
 
 TrustArc Cookie Consent Integration : Automatically injects and configures TrustArc’s consent banner on your Drupal site. 
 Google Consent Mode Support : Adjusts Google Analytics and Google Ads behavior based on user consent. 
 Google-certified CMP Partner (Gold Status) : TrustArc is a Google-certified CMP partner with a gold status for web and mobile, excelling in customer service and support. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 After installing the module:

 
 Navigate to Configuration > TrustArc Consent Manager to enter your TrustArc integration settings. 
 Test the integration to ensure the banner is loading correctly 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 
 TrustArc Account : A TrustArc subscription is required to obtain the necessary API keys. 
 Google Consent Mode : Integrates with Google Analytics and Google Ads. 
 
 Recommended Modules/Libraries 
 
 Google Tag Manager : Enhances tracking capabilities and ensures proper handling of consent-based script execution.
